profile.Name: Horse
profile.Personality: Eager and greedy, with a traitorous streak. He is restless in a sleepy village and quick to believe a juicy rumor of loot.
profile.Backstory: His treasure-hunting squad was killed by cannibals, and he now waits in the bar of the Fishing Village on the Northern Coast, unable to pay his bill. A man in a bar told him of a sand tower north of the painted cannibal lair, full of ancient tech and guarded by a sleeping giant beast.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Talks like a pitchman ('Here's the deal', 'We'll be rich!') and gets loud and excited about strange sights and loot.
